ExtraTasks.Name: Harden Microsoft Entra Connect sync
ExtraTasks.Doc:
## Overview

The sync server and its accounts can take over cloud identities if they're misconfigured. Block soft and hard matching, turn off seamless single sign-on where you no longer need it, keep the krbtgt_AzureAD account out of sync, and turn off the temporary bypass for onPremisesObjectIdentifier updates. Conditional Access policies should exclude the directory synchronization accounts so sync keeps running.

This task isn't in the Zero Trust Workshop. Maester adds it because these settings are a common route from on-premises to the cloud.
